subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be modeled as a new `dmThreadMode` account setting, or should it extend the existing `replyToMode` threading contract?
rationale: Source review can identify the missing contract pieces, but choosing the permanent user-facing config API affects compatibility, docs, and future Google Chat threading behavior.

options.title: Use the existing replyToMode contract
options.body: Route the feature through `replyToMode` or a clearly documented extension of it so Google Chat has one threading configuration model.

options.title: Accept a separate dmThreadMode key
options.body: Keep the new DM-only setting, but require exported types, generated metadata, docs/help, and live default/opt-in proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind canonical thread work
options.body: Defer this branch until the open Google Chat thread-routing PR settles the surrounding reply-target behavior.

recommendation.title: Use the existing replyToMode contract
recommendation.body: Route the feature through `replyToMode` or a clearly documented extension of it so Google Chat has one threading configuration model.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the prior DM-thread suppression, Google Chat thread support, and verification path.
